newsitem.title: BELGIUM: AEA air cargo shows drop in N Atlantic traffic Feb.
newsitem.headline: AEA air cargo shows drop in N Atlantic traffic Feb.

text.p: The Association of European Airlines(AEA) freight traffic figures for February show the tonnage carried by air is running above year-ago levels.
But it said the overall growth rate was modest at 1.5 percent, with the Far East continued to out-perform the North Atlantic.

*These figures relate to the international scheduled services of AEA member airlines and they are quoted in revenue freight tonne kilometres.

All comparisons for February should take into account that February 1996 included an extra day, which depressed the February 1997 growth figures by about 3.5 percentage points,the AEA stated. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
